name: savvy-codex
description: Savvy orchestration with Claude and subscription-authenticated Codex workers in the same native Agents panel.

pythonPath.title: Python executable
pythonPath.description: Python 3.10+ executable path or name; blank uses SAVVY_CODEX_PYTHON, then platform default.

pluginRoot.title: Plugin directory override
pluginRoot.description: Optional absolute plugin root; blank uses environment or the skills-dir install location.

helperPath.title: Executor script override
helperPath.description: Optional absolute codex_delegate.py path for custom installations.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: Agents 侧栏语言；auto 跟随 Claude Code 设置与系统语言。

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy 由流程或 Codex worker 启动时打开同一侧栏；any 也跟随普通 Claude 子代理。
